999008199.text: かき氷、美味し～！　疲れた身体に染みるー

localizations.en: This shaved ice is so good~! It's just what my tired body needed.

999008199.text:
姉様が望むなら、何杯分でも氷を砕いてみせるわ。
一世一代の大仕事に筋肉も喜んでいる

localizations.en: If that's what you want, I'll crush as much ice as it takes. My muscles are more than happy to rise to the occasion.

999008199.text:
んじゃ、お言葉に甘えておかわりしようかな～。
ヤドヴィガはどう？　美味しい？

localizations.en: Well, if you insist, maybe I will get seconds~. How about you, Jadwiga? Is it good?

999008199.text:
大変美味。
氷に味を付けただけなのに、なぜこんなにも……

localizations.en: Exceptionally so. It is merely ice with flavoring added, yet somehow...

999008199.text:
アルビちゃん特製「錬金術シロップ」よ！
んふふ、頬当てがないと表情がよく分かっていいね

localizations.en: That's my special alchemic syrup! Heheh. And it's nice to see your expression so clearly without that visor in the way.

999008199.text: 表情……そんなに変わってるかな

localizations.en: My expression... is it really that different?

999008199.text:
アタシ、人の表情の変化を見るのには自信があるんだ。
いつもベップのこと、よく見てるしね

localizations.en: I'm pretty confident when it comes to reading people's faces. I do keep a close eye on you, after all.

999008199.text: いつも見てるなんて、姉様……

localizations.en: You keep a close eye on me... Alvina...

999008199.text: よし、じゃあ作戦会議するよ！

localizations.en: Alright, time for a strategy meeting!

999008199.text:
この旅行の目的は、ヤンネさんとヤドヴィガに
行楽地での休暇を楽しんでもらうこと！

localizations.en: The goal of this trip is to give Janne and Jadwiga a real taste of what a proper vacation looks like!

999008199.text:
だけどヤンネさんは真面目な人だから、
休暇に来ても鍛錬や仕事で動き回ってる

localizations.en: The thing is, Janne is such a dedicated person that even on vacation, she ends up training or running around on business.

999008199.text:
そうなんだよね。だから鍛錬よりも
魅力的な休暇を提案しようって思うんだけど――

localizations.en: Exactly. So I was thinking we pitch her a vacation idea more appealing than training, but...

999008199.text:
休暇……休んでほしいなら、
ヤンネと戦い、倒してでも休ませればいい

localizations.en: Vacation... If you want her to rest, we could simply challenge Janne in combat and force her to stand down.

999008199.text: 九偉人、物騒……

localizations.en: One of the Miraculous Nine, and still somehow terrifying...

999008199.text:
ヤンネさんは神聖国最強の聖戦士だよ？
それはまず無理だって……それに――

localizations.en: Janne is the strongest Sacred Knight in all of Nova! That's just not going to happen... Besides—

999008199.text:
休暇は楽しんで、いい思い出にしてほしいからさ。
されて嬉しいことだけで企画したいんだ

localizations.en: I want this to be a vacation she actually enjoys—something she can look back on fondly. So let's only plan things that'll genuinely make her happy.

999008199.text: されて嬉しいこと……
……難しい

うん。何をされて嬉しいかは人それぞれだもん。
相手のことをよーく考えないとね

localizations.en: It is, isn't it. What makes someone happy is different for everyone. You really have to think carefully about the other person.

999008199.text: うーん……
おお、そこにいるのは！！
ん、この声はもしかしなくても……

localizations.en: Hm, that voice... I think I know who that is.

999008199.text:
お前たちも行楽に来ているのか！
はっはっは！　なんとも奇遇だな！

localizations.en: So you've come here for the holidays as well! Ha ha ha! What a wonderful coincidence!

999008199.text:
皆様、こんにちは……
ふふ、これも、神のお導きでしょうか

localizations.en: Good day, everyone... Hehe. Perhaps this too is the will of the gods.

999008199.text:
鏑矢さんに、千歳！
わ、すっごい水着似合ってる！！

localizations.en: Kaburaya! And Chitose! Wow, you both look amazing in your swimsuits!!

999008199.text:
そうであろうそうであろう？
千歳の水着姿、実に愛いであろう？

localizations.en: Do we not? Does Chitose not look absolutely adorable?

999008199.text: して、三人で何か悩んでいるようだったが……

localizations.en: Now then, it looked as though you three were troubled about something...

999008199.text:
余に話してみよ！
内容次第では、力になろう

localizations.en: Tell me what it is. Depending on the matter, I may be able to help.

999008199.text:
ケイウン南部を統治する堂免家の若き当主。
ゼレンタ島に休暇を楽しみに来た

localizations.en: The young head of the Doumen family, which governs southern Keiun. Came to Zerenta Island to enjoy the holidays.

999008199.text:
物静かで儚い印象の、堂免家付きの巫女。
ゼレンタ島に休暇を楽しみに来た

localizations.en: A shrine maiden of the Doumen family, quiet and delicate in manner. Came to Zerenta Island to enjoy the holidays.
